findings.issue: Hiphil imperfect 3ms causes the tooth to fall: the unnamed masculine singular is the agent and the tooth is the patient. Spanish makes diente the subject of hace caer and names no patient.
findings.spanishSpan: diente de su siervo o diente de su sierva hace caer

findings.issue: תחת is only a preposition, open between under and in place of. debajo de locks the spatial under sense.
HRd and the לַ surface include the definite article on the adjective free. a libre does not mark it.

notes: lo matches the 3ms suffix on the send verb; su siervo / su sierva match the two construct phrases.
